class_reason: All six targets reproduce exactly at the paper's printed precision from the unmodified deposited scripts and data (and 21 of 21 Table 3 cells match to 3 decimals).
confidence_reason: Deterministic correlations and counts on the deposited file, scripts run unmodified, every deposited file matches the PREREG sha256; agreement with agent A not yet checked by compare_ab.py.
uncertainties: The Dataverse API on 2026-10-10 reports versionNumber 1, versionMinorNumber 1 (PREREG.md says version 1.0). All 49 files are byte-identical to the PREREG sha256 list, so this does not affect the run.
T1 matches Table 3 (0.636); the prose says '.63' (PREREG inconsistency note). Median 0.398 reproduces the computed median of the printed table; the prose '.39' looks truncated (not a target).
Robustness p-values of 0 from cor.test are below double precision, not exactly zero. The R_a p-value is the pre-registered bootstrap proportion (no resample had T1 <= 0).
In R_c the largest pair is LIED-AoW, not ARD-AoW; still below 0.73.
Appendix and data-preparation scripts were not run (PREREG: merged data used as deposited).
